g.text: Title: Long-range remote LITE - control board (4 x AA NiMH)

g.desc: Title: Long-range remote LITE - control board (4 x AA NiMH)

g.text: AA pack -> power gate -> LEDs; LED switch; pack sense; six keys; connectors

g.desc: AA pack -> power gate -> LEDs; LED switch; pack sense; six keys; connectors

g.text: The LEDs light only while ARM (GPIO2) powers them through Q5 AND the carrier on IR_DRV (GPIO17) switches Q2. LED head: 33 strings of 2 x SFH 4545 + 24R.

g.desc: The LEDs light only while ARM (GPIO2) powers them through Q5 AND the carrier on IR_DRV (GPIO17) switches Q2. LED head: 33 strings of 2 x SFH 4545 + 24R.

g.text: C. J2 - Waveshare ESP32-S3-RLCD-4.2 2x8 header (16-way ribbon, pin n = pin n)

g.desc: C. J2 - Waveshare ESP32-S3-RLCD-4.2 2x8 header (16-way ribbon, pin n = pin n)

g.text: Q5 (P-FET) connects the pack to the LEDs only while ARM is high. R14 holds it off; Q6 pulls its gate

g.desc: Q5 (P-FET) connects the pack to the LEDs only while ARM is high. R14 holds it off; Q6 pulls its gate

g.text: when cells go in. R4 holds ARM low while the ESP32 boots. Pack sense: BATT / 2 (470k + 470k, 5 uA) on GPIO1.

g.desc: when cells go in. R4 holds ARM low while the ESP32 boots. Pack sense: BATT / 2 (470k + 470k, 5 uA) on GPIO1.

g.text: down through R15 (Vgs = -0.91 x pack). C7 (gate-drain) is a soft start, C8 (gate-source) keeps Q5 off

g.desc: down through R15 (Vgs = -0.91 x pack). C7 (gate-drain) is a soft start, C8 (gate-source) keeps Q5 off

g.text: Q2 is logic-level (5.7 mOhm max at Vgs 2.5 V): GPIO17 drives it directly. R6 47R slows its edge so

g.desc: Q2 is logic-level (5.7 mOhm max at Vgs 2.5 V): GPIO17 drives it directly. R6 47R slows its edge so

g.text: the ribbon can't ring the LEDs into reverse bias (sim/). R7 holds Q2 off while the ESP32 boots.

g.desc: the ribbon can't ring the LEDs into reverse bias (sim/). R7 holds Q2 off while the ESP32 boots.

g.text: D. Keys - each shorts its GPIO to GND; ESP32 internal pull-ups

g.desc: D. Keys - each shorts its GPIO to GND; ESP32 internal pull-ups

g.text: Used: 3/4 GND, 5 GPIO0 SELECT (also BOOT), 7 GPIO1 pack / 2, 9 GPIO2 ARM, 10 GPIO43 RIGHT (via R11), 11 GPIO3 DOWN,

g.desc: Used: 3/4 GND, 5 GPIO0 SELECT (also BOOT), 7 GPIO1 pack / 2, 9 GPIO2 ARM, 10 GPIO43 RIGHT (via R11), 11 GPIO3 DOWN,

g.text: A. Battery, pack sense and LED power gate

g.desc: A. Battery, pack sense and LED power gate

g.text: 12 GPIO44 LEFT, 13 GPIO17 IR_DRV, 15 GPIO18 UP (also KEY), 16 GPIO14 BACK (I2C SCL, 2.2k pull-up on the display board).

g.desc: 12 GPIO44 LEFT, 13 GPIO17 IR_DRV, 15 GPIO18 UP (also KEY), 16 GPIO14 BACK (I2C SCL, 2.2k pull-up on the display board).

g.text: B. LED switch (Q2) and LED head connector (J5)

g.desc: B. LED switch (Q2) and LED head connector (J5)

g.text: J5 -> LED head J1 over the 10-way ribbon: odd pins VBAT (LED_PWR), even pins LED_RTN.

g.desc: J5 -> LED head J1 over the 10-way ribbon: odd pins VBAT (LED_PWR), even pins LED_RTN.

g.text: Not connected: 1 3V3, 2 VBUS, 6/8 USB D-/D+, 14 SDA. The display board and ESP32 run from their own 18650.

g.desc: Not connected: 1 3V3, 2 VBUS, 6/8 USB D-/D+, 14 SDA. The display board and ESP32 run from their own 18650.

g.text: R11: GPIO43 is UART TX during the boot ROM; 1k limits the current if RIGHT is held at power-up.

g.desc: R11: GPIO43 is UART TX during the boot ROM; 1k limits the current if RIGHT is held at power-up.

g.text: LITE control board - LEDs from a 4 x AA NiMH pack; keys straight to ESP32 GPIOs

g.desc: LITE control board - LEDs from a 4 x AA NiMH pack; keys straight to ESP32 GPIOs
